title: Ask the way and catch the train
objective: Ask where something is and understand left, right and straight on.
explanation: “Hvor er …?” asks where something is: “Hvor er stationen?” Directions use “til venstre” (left), “til højre” (right) and “ligeud” (straight on). For transport: “Hvornår kører toget til Aarhus?” (When does the train to Aarhus leave?) — trains, buses and cars all “kører”.
sourceReference: Deepwater original starter course (2026-10-29), written for Echo; teacher review required before publishing.

exercises.prompt: Complete: “___ er toilettet?” (Where is the toilet?)
Complete: “Hvornår ___ bussen?” (When does the bus leave?)
Write how to get from your front door to the nearest shop in three short Danish steps, using ligeud, til venstre or til højre.
